title: feat: expose variable model pricing
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds display-safe `pricing_adjustments` metadata to the public model catalog while keeping executable billing rules private.
- Replaces the generic tiered-pricing tooltip with a programmatic `@pollinations/ui` dropdown and pricing ledger on desktop and mobile.
- Covers Gemini and Perplexity search fees plus realtime billing adjustments without model-specific UI logic.
- Adds an unauthenticated endpoint check and registry-wide metadata coverage.

Checks:
- `npm run typecheck --workspace pollinations-enter`
- `npm run build:frontend --workspace pollinations-enter`
- 81 focused Enter pricing/catalog tests
- Gen unauthenticated model-pricing test
- Desktop and mobile browser verification

gist.headline: The price tags grew brains
gist.blurb: The model garden now shows the little costs hiding between the petals. Search fees, realtime adjustments, and variable pricing have stopped pretending they are one-size-fits-all.
gist.summary: The public model catalog now exposes display-safe pricing_adjustments metadata and uses a responsive pricing ledger dropdown to show Gemini and Perplexity search fees plus realtime billing adjustments without exposing private billing rules.
gist.impact: People comparing models can now inspect the concrete variable charges that apply to a model on desktop or mobile, while the underlying executable billing logic stays private.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model-price garden where Polli helps a friendly CRT monitor robot read a clear pricing ledger instead of a vague signpost. Small labeled pixel flowers represent Gemini search, Perplexity search, and realtime adjustments, with distinct coins and ledger rows showing that model costs can have useful extra details; code-plants reinforce that the catalog metadata is structured and shared safely.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wearing tiny accountant glasses as she opens a neat pixel pricing ledger beside a curious chunky CRT monitor robot. Gemini, Perplexity, and realtime code-flowers grow from lime green (#ecf874) pots with simple pixel labels, while the monitor displays a tidy dropdown of price adjustments; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, warm cream and lavender background, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic but beautiful.
